geometry: Two broad turf terraces occupy the front and rear halves of the island, joined by two wide cream-earth ramps on the left and right. Exactly two low rounded boulders sit near the sheltered centre, one toward each starting side. A chunky open wind arch occupies the rear-right verge. Its visible corridor follows the outer right edge, with two short pennants showing direction and a clear calm centre.

signatureFeature.physicalObjects: A rounded wind arch stands behind two broad, connected terraces. A narrow marked wind corridor crosses one edge of the arena; the centre remains sheltered.
signatureFeature.activation: The shared match rules declare the gust schedule and direction. The resident lowers a visible pennant before each gust; grass and pennants move in the same direction.
signatureFeature.consequence: An exposed airborne fighter or eligible light projectile drifts sideways in the corridor. A fighter can time a dive, push an opponent into the corridor or attack from its sheltered edge.
counterplay: Stay in the sheltered centre during the warning.
Land or brace before entering the corridor.
Use a supported attack whose travel is unaffected by the declared gust rule.
limits: Gusts affect a declared area and eligible objects; they never randomly reverse.
The arch creates no speed change outside its corridor.
The resident provides the same warning to both fighters and never targets either one.
visualEvidence: Pennant and grass signal the approaching gust.
Wind crosses the same visible corridor.
A wing or eligible projectile visibly drifts, or the defender braces.
A fighter's attack exploits or fails to exploit that displacement.

resident.perch: Rear-left verge beside a short pennant pole, with a clear view of the arch and centre.

reset: Restore cover, water, feature phase and every displaced object to the same declared starting state before each bout.
